title: TWIN-MAP: analysis code for a global population-to-single-cell framework for early prediction, prevention or treatment of cancer trajectories
description:
Code accompanying the manuscript TWIN-MAP: a global population-to-single-cell framework for early prediction, prevention or treatment of cancer trajectories.

Prong 1: identification of cancer trajectories in UK Biobank electronic health records (Match-DT) and comparison with the Danish Disease Trajectory Browser. Prong 2A: pathway similarity between risk diseases and cancers from bulk transcriptomic data. Prong 2B: single-cell pseudotime signatures for prostate, colorectal and lung cancer. Prong 3A: prediction of incident cancer from UK Biobank plasma proteomics. Prong 3B: drug-target enrichment of the signature genes.

UK Biobank data cannot be redistributed; synthetic stand-in data are provided to run the Prong 3A models.
